items.headline: Lane Kiffin reflective in defeat, as LSU falls to Ole Miss
items.description: After his LSU Tigers fell to the Ole Miss Rebels 32-24 on Saturday night, coach Lane Kiffin spoke of the "emotions of gratefulness" he has for Oxford, Mississippi, and the six years he and his family spent there, a tenure that "went well beyond football."

items.headline: A cathartic win 293 days in the making: Hanging in The Grove for Lane Kiffin's return
items.description: After unmatched hype and buildup -- and an epic scene at The Grove -- Ole Miss got the best of Lane Kiffin and LSU.

items.headline: Golding: Beating LSU 'sweet' but not Ole Miss' 'Super Bowl'
items.description: While Ole Miss is basking in its victory over former coach Lane Kiffin and his LSU Tigers, Pete Golding cautioned that his team is aiming for higher goals this season.
